snippet.title: KILL JACK - Trailer | PSX Horror Blackjack
snippet.description:
KILL JACK is a horror blackjack roguelike with a PSX look.

In the twenties Jack ran a casino by the sea. The casino is gone. Jack is still dealing.

You wake up in his cellar. One lamp, one table, and a television that only gets channel 3. Every chip on your side of the felt is one of your lives, and every chip on his side is one of his. A tie goes to the shotgun.

KILL JACK on itch.io: https://tigerunity.itch.io/kill-jack

Made in Godot. Contains jump scares, flashing lights, firearms and blood.

#horror #indiegame #blackjack
